title: The Continent of Archanea
description: An ancient land forged by dragonkind and human kingdoms. Following the War of Shadows, Prince Marth embarks on a campaign to liberate the realm from the Dolhr Empire.

regions.name: Kingdom of Talys
regions.description: A tranquil island kingdom located off the southeastern coast of the Archanean mainland. It granted refuge to Prince Marth of Altea after his homeland fell to Dolhr.

regions.name: Port Town of Galder
regions.description: A busy port town on the northeastern coast of the Lefcandith Peninsula. Overrun by Galder pirates allied with Dolhr, it serves as Marth's first mainland battleground.

regions.name: Devil Mountain (Samsoian)
regions.description: A treacherous, craggy mountain range infested with vicious bandits. The brave swordfighter Navarre and deserters Julian and Lena seek escape here.

regions.name: Kingdom of Aurelis
regions.description: A vast northern kingdom of boundless grasslands and noble cavalrymen. Prince Hardin leads the Wolfguard and protects Princess Nyna of Archanea against Macedon's forces.

regions.name: Kingdom of Altea
regions.description: The homeland of the heroic Anri and Prince Marth. Famed for its valiant paladins, it was betrayed by neighboring Gra and overrun by the forces of Dolhr.

regions.name: Kingdom of Gra
regions.description: A kingdom born alongside Altea, which betrayed King Cornelius during the Battle of Menendi, resulting in Altea's catastrophic collapse.

regions.name: Kingdom of Grust
regions.description: A mighty military empire on the southwestern coast possessing the famed Sable Order. Reluctantly allied with Dolhr due to cowardice of its king.

regions.name: Kingdom of Macedon
regions.description: A rugged southern land of forests and volcanic peaks, home to the ferocious Dracoknights and the Whitewings pegasus knights.

regions.name: City of Magic Khadein
regions.description: A mystical city of sorcery isolated deep in the western burning desert sands. The cradle of elemental magic and scholarly wisdom.

regions.name: Holy Kingdom of Archanea (Pales)
regions.description: The millennium-old heart and supreme monarchy of the continent. Its capital Pales was ransacked by Dolhr, forcing Princess Nyna into exile.

regions.name: Dolhr Dragon Empire
regions.description: A dark, impenetrable domain of primal jungles and ancient dragon fortresses ruled by the revived Shadow Dragon Medeus.

routes.name: Traversing the Ghoul's Teeth to Aurelis

b1_ch01: Prince Marth of Altea was driven from his homeland by the Dolhr Empire.
He was protected by a small band of knights, led by the veteran knight, Jagen.
He escaped, after much struggle, to the eastern island kingdom of Talys.
The Kingdom of Talys was a small, remote country that did not even have its own order of knights.
The King of Talys lent his eastern fortress to Marth and his knights, and provided him with all the assistance he could.
He spoke gently to Marth, who was trembling with frustration after his parents were killed and his beloved sister was captured.
He said, "Prince Marth... I understand your concern for your sister.
However you're only 14 years old. You are far too young to fight against the Empire.
Be patient for now. Stay in this land, gather your strength, and wait for the right time..."
Protected by the kindness of the people of Talys, Marth spent 2 years in this country.
And then, one day, when he was about to turn 16...

b1_ch02: Across the sea from the Kingdom of Talys was Galder Harbor.
It was originally a poor, but peaceful port town.
However, one day it was suddenly attacked by a pirate gang and it has since been their stronghold.
It was here in Galder Harbor that Marth took his first steps toward liberating his homeland.
chapter_02: Across the sea from the Kingdom of Talys was Galder Harbor.
It was originally a poor, but peaceful port town.
However, one day it was suddenly attacked by a pirate gang and it has since been their stronghold.
It was here in Galder Harbor that Marth took his first steps toward liberating his homeland.
b1_ch03: The greatest obstacle to crossing from the frontier regions to Archanea is
The rugged mountain range known as Samsooth, which streches across the peninsula from north to south.
For some time, bandits have lurked in these mountains, attacking nearby villages and travellers.
Raids, abductions, setting fires... Their wicked deeds know no bounds.
Out of fear, the people call the mountain Devil Mountain.
And they call those who dwell on Samsooth the demonic Soothsires...
chapter_03: The greatest obstacle to crossing from the frontier regions to Archanea is
The rugged mountain range known as Samsooth, which streches across the peninsula from north to south.
For some time, bandits have lurked in these mountains, attacking nearby villages and travellers.
Raids, abductions, setting fires... Their wicked deeds know no bounds.
Out of fear, the people call the mountain Devil Mountain.
And they call those who dwell on Samsooth the demonic Soothsires...
b1_ch04: The grasslands to the northeast of the continent belong to the Kingdom of Aurelis.
Since its founding, this powerful northern kingdom has had a close relationship with the Holy Kingdom of Archanea.
While other nations have already fallen, and most of the territory of Aurelis has been occupied by Macedon,
Duke Hardin, known as the Wolf of the Plains, remained unyielding and continued to fight bravely.
Princess Nyna of Archanea had sought refurge with Duke Hardin,
and for several months she had been issuing calls to arms to overthrow the Dolhr Empire...
But with their desparate cries unanswered, and facing the elite Macedonian army, their fates appeared to be sealed...
b1_ch05: After defeating the main force of the Macedonian army, the allied army advanced further to liberate Aurelis Castle.
They had to recover the valuable treasures hidden inside the castle before the enemy stole them.
"The chests can only be opened by Thieves, but do we have any within our ranks?"
b1_ch06: After liberating Aurelis, the allied army marched south along the central road towards Archanea's capital city, Pales.
Their greatest obstacle was the numerous forts built in Lefcandy Valley,
as well as the guarding Dragon Knights and Macedonian Whitewings under the command of General Minerva.
In Lefcandy Valley, the only passageway to the Kingdom of Archanea, an intense battle was about to begin.
b1_ch07: General Minerva's sudden retreat allowed the allied forces to safely enter the territory of Archanea.
To allow their soldiers to rest, they stopped at the port town of Warren, which was known for its trading port.
The town maintained its autonomy by paying substantial taxes to the Empire, and was
also favorably disposed towards the allied army.
In this town, which was surrounded by sea and mountains and protected by many mercenaries,
the soldiers were happy to get some much-needed rest.
...But, as if to mock them, a message arrived informing them of an enemy attack.
b1_ch08: Having accepted Catria's request, Prince Marth decided to mount an attack on the fortress of Deil,
to rescue Princess Maria of Macedon, who was being held hostage there.
Within the allied army, some suggested that it was a trap set by General Minerva.
However, Marth didn't believe that the gentle-looking woman
he had seen at the battle of Lefcandy was the terrifying enemy that everyone described.
She had the same eyes as his older sister... She looked so sad and pained...
In Minerva, Marth saw the figure of his older sister, Elice,
who had been captured by the Empire in his place, and whose whereabouts were unknown.
Princess Maria must be rescued. Then perhaps Minerva could also be saved...
Marth had decided on this course of action.
b1_ch09: After a long battle, the allied army, led by Marth, had finally reached Nyna's homeland of Archanea.
The golden city of Pales, also known as the Millennium Palace, lay beyond this mountain.
Many of its treasures had been stolen, and there were many soldiers imprisoned within.
Marth's long journey was about to reach one of its decisive chapters.
b1_ch10: Approximately 600 years ago, the Holy Kingdom of Archanea was formed through the unification of the many city-states in the region.
The founder of Archanea, King Adrah the First, was said to have embarked on a holy war to unify the continent, wielding
three sacred weapons entrusted to him by the gods.
Since then, the Kingdom of Archanea had been called the Holy Kingdom, a nation protected by the gods.
The royal bloodline had been highly revered by the people.
The fact that 6 kingdoms had recently gained independence was entirely due to the assistance of Archanea.
Prince Marth was about to set foot in the great holy city of Pales in Archanea for the very first time.
b1_ch11: Gra had long been an ally of Altea. However, during the war against Grust, they suddenly betrayed Altea.
The Altean army was attacked from behind and completely annihilated.
Altea's King Cornelius disappeared at Gra, and the Falchion sword along with him.
Two years had passed since that tragic day...
Marth has finally arrived at Gra Castle, which was guarded by Jiol, the man who drove his father to his death.
b1_ch12: Khadein was known as the land of magic.
It was a sanctuary for mages, ruled by the Dark Pontifex, Gharnef.
When the mages cast their spells, even the bravest soldiers have no way of defending themselves.
Brave soldiers fall, wounded and defeated.
Khadein... A cursed city of darkness...
b1_ch13: After a crushing defeat at the hands of Gharnef and his dark magic, Imhullu,
Prince Marth marched his army south, to achieve his hope of reclaiming his homeland of Altea.
The Kingdom of Altea was a beautiful country, surrounded by abundant water and lush vegetation.
However, since its occupation by Dolhr, the country had
fallen into ruin, and its people had endured long years of suffering.
But now, they were about to witness the long-awaited day of liberation.
b1_ch14: After defeating Holstad's knights, the allied army swiftly conquered all of Altea.
All that remained was the forces of the Mage Dragon Morzas, which were holed up in Altea Castle.
Morzas succeeded General Camus as the commander of the occupation army, and was a ruthless man guilty of killing many people.
Marth was now about to confront the hateful Morzas once again.
b1_ch15: In order to obtain the Lightsphere and sacred treasures which the Archsage Gotoh sought,
Marth and his companions headed for Chiasmir's Fane of Raman.
At Chiasmir strait, they engaged in a fierce battle with the Grustian Sable Order, who attempted to prevent them
Though they were once known as the world's finest,
the Grustian Sable Order no longer possessed their former glory and were defeated.
Then, at Raman... The temple of Naga, where ancient treasures are said to lie, Another story was about to begin...
b1_ch16: The Kingdom of Grust was a nation of knights, which was founded by one of the three heroes of the liberation wars, General Ordwin.
Since its founding, backed by the power of its formidable
knightly order, it subjugated the neighboring uncivilized tribes, and eventually became
one of the strongest of Archanea's seven kingdoms.
However, the current King, Louis, was weak.
He feared the power of the resurrected Medeus, so he allied with Dolhr.
Following a series of defeats, King Louis fell ill.
The once brave and mighty Kingdom of Grust was now on the verge of collapse.
b1_ch17: Minerva and Maria's homeland, Macedon, was a peaceful and prosperous kingdom known as
However, its ambitious Prince Michalis ignored his sisters' objections and aided Dolhr with its ambitions.
He led the Macedonian Dragon Knights to attack numerous countries, instilling fear in the people.
With a vast army that seemed to fill the entire sky,
he was about to challenge Marth and his allies to a final battle...
b1_ch18: Marth and his companions were transported by Archsage Gotoh's great Warp magic to the ancient city of Thabes.
Once, it was a proud city, boasting advanced civilization, but now it was desolate and lifeless...
In the center of the city stood the Topwer of Thabes... It was there that the Dark Pontifex Gharnef resided.
Marth and his companions needed to recover the lost divine Falchion sword...
And, they needed to rescue Princess Elice, who was captured by Gharnef...
b1_ch19: The kingdom of Manaketes was shrouded in a veil of mystery.
Everything started with the resurrection of the Shadow Dragon, Medeus, in this land.
The continent of Archanea had been ruined by endless war.
Many tragic tales began and ended,
Medeus's ambitions of Manaketes ruling the world must finally be brought to an end.
And Marth's journey must also reach its final destination.
b1_ch20: After a fierce battle, the allied army had driven the enemy to Dolhr Castle.
They had surrounded the castle, and attempted to storm in through four open gates.
However, this was a trap set by Medeus to separate Marth's forces.
The final battle of life and death was about to begin.
The battle between those chosen by fate...
b2_ch01: One year had passed since the War of Darkness ended.
Thanks to the efforts of Prince Marth, the Kingdom of Altea, devastated by war, finally began to stabilize.
The knight Jagen, who succeeded the ill Malledus, became the prince's advisor and helped him with national affairs.
Afterwards, Princess Sheeda was welcomed to Altea, and her marriage with Prince Marth was announced.
The citizens of Altea were delighted to see the couple happy together, and welcomed Sheeda warmly. However...
Soon before the wedding day, an order was suddenly delivered from the imperial palace of Pales.
It appears that a large-scale rebellion has broken out in the Kingdom of Grust, which is under Archanea's occupation.
I request for your country to subdue Grust.
Your highness is to send Altea's full army immediately, to quell Grust's rebellion. -Emperor Hardin."
The Kingdom of Archanea was the suzerain state to Altea, so its orders must be followed.
Marth, unable to refuse, ordered the knight Cain to protect his kingdom.
Together with Jagen and the others, he set out on an expedition to Grust.
b2_ch02: With regretful feelings, Marth and his companions left Grust and landed in Macedon to rescue Princess Minerva.
After the war of Darkness, Macedon was ruled by Princess Minerva, who expelled the generals
who had been oppressing the people, and worked to reform the army.
However, the powerful General Rucke opposed Minerva's actions.
He gathered the ousted soldiers and staged a coup.
Minerva was caught unprepared and was captured by Rucke's followers.
Macedon then fell under the control of the rebels.
They then dispached a powerful unit of dragon knights to the forest at the nation's border, to strengthen their defences.
b2_ch03: The region now known as Macedon was once part of the Dolhr Empire.
100 years ago, the dragon tribe, who rued the entire continent, sent a large number
of slaves into the untamed wilds of Macedon.
The slaves were forced to excavate ancient ruins and develop the land.
Many were denied food, forced to work against their will, whipped, and then killed.
Amidst these tragic conditions, one young man named Iote rose up.
He and his companions escaped from the forests and fought, riding dragons, for the liberation of the slaves.
After Dolhr's fall, the slaves established their own country in the fertile land that they had cultivated.
The hero Iote was welcomed as its first king.
This was how the Kingdom of Macedon, later feared as the land of dragon knights, was born.
However, the mighty nation of Macedon had lost its Prince Michalis, said to be the second coming of Iote.
It had also stood to lose Princess Minerva, who was also known as the Crimson Dragoon.
b2_ch04: Unable to reunite with Princess Minerva, Marth set out to find Ogma and the Grustian royal children.
He dicided to visit bishop Wendell, who had once been their guardian.
The bishop resided at Holm Coast, which was ruled by the infamous Macedonian Vikings.
Countless pirates lay in wait, blocking the path of Marth and his companions.
Will they be able to rescue the children safely?...
b2_ch05: Caeda's disturbing news was a terrible blow to Marth.
Hardin was once a comrade that Marth had fought alongside. He was a trusted and irreplaceable friend.
"But why...? Why has he attacked Altea? What have I done to incur his wrath?" He thought.
Shaking with frustration, Marth and his companions hurried back to their
homeland, only to find the first of many obstacles in their path.
They had reached Olbern Castle, the headquarters of the Grustian occupation forces
headed by the evil General Lang. Its nickname was the "Nest of Evil".
b2_ch06: The last holdout was Olbern Castle, guarded by the commander of the occupation army, General Lang.
Lang had used his position to steal possessions from the Grustian citizens, to abduct young girls, and to take lives.
He was among the cruellest men in history.
"He cannot be allowed to live. I will definitely defeat him!"
Prince Marth raised his sword towards the skies and shouted out an order:
b2_ch07: After liberating Grust, Marth accepted Wendell's request to find the lost Spheres, and headed to the Fane of Raman.
However, the ancient temple, which was built to worship Naga, had been ruined by constant war and had now become a hideout for thieves.
"They're escaping with the temple's precious treasures. We must not let them take them. We must recover them!"
"We must not attract the attention of the mercenaries guarding Chiasmir Bridge.
We don't stand a chance of winning, so be sure not to approach them."
"Also, it seems that a travelling dancer has lost her way in the forest.
We must rescue her before she gets ambushed by the thieves!"
After the troops received their orders, they surrounded The Fane of Raman.
The flame of a new battle was about to ignite.
b2_ch08: After reclaiming the Fane of Raman, Marth and his companions, fearing pursuit by Archanea's army, fled
However, just as they reached the central islet, the Altean army was attacked by a new enemy.
"Archanea's army is approaching from the north. If we continue like this, we will be surrounded."
The situation was dire. Can Marth and the others safely overcome this danger?
b2_ch09: Having barely managed to escape, Marth landed in the Khadein Desert.
He then waited for the rest of his troops to catch up.
The magic city, Khadein, was a sanctuary for mages.
Many prospective mages came to this land to undergo rigorous training.
Magic involves sealing the power of nature into tomes and staves, and freely using them to unleash great power.
Hundreds of years ago, a sage founded an academy in this land where he taught his secret techiniques to the people.
While it was originally designed to bring happiness to people, magic was used in wars and was bought and sold for money.
The sage was disappointed and disappeared without a trace.
Some people say that the sage was the legendary Archsage Gotoh.
Currently, only a very small number of high bishops are able to create tomes and staves.
Even they can only create lower-level magic, such as Fire and Heal.
More powerful magic like Aura cannot be created without the power of the Sacred Spheres.
Furthermore, those who can wield such powerful magic are limited in number.
The users are determined by the creator, and the tomes can only be passed down by the will of the chosen person.
Magic city Khadein... A proud Sanctuary of Sorcery.
b2_ch10: Khadein was a free city. It was not under the rule of any country, and was thus a sovereign nation.
There were numerous high bishops under the ruling Pontifex, and the city was run by their council.
However, because Pontifex Gharnef joined forces with Dolhr in the previous war, the city was dragged into
After losing all of its high bishops, Khadein was ruled by the newly appointed Pontifex, Wendell, who embarked on the
However, Wendell set out on a journey to fulfill Archsage Gotoh's mission. He entrusted Khadein's affairs to two young men before
Merric and Arlen... They were both exemplary young men with promising futures.
b2_ch11: Seeking the Lightsphere, Marth headed towards the Tower of Thabes.
Buried beneath the sands lay the ancient city of Thabes, along with many priceless treasures.
The legend of Thabes, the city of illusion, has lured many men to the desert.
However... None of them have ever returned.
In the words of the sages...
Do not approach Marmothod, the Desert of Death. It is a cursed city of darkness.
b2_ch12: Marth and his companions followed Xane and headed north.
Through High mountains... Steep cliffs... Deep valleys...
Then, after crossing countless mountains... Suddenly, they were covercome by a piercing heat.
Lava flowed out in rivers, roaring loudly and blocking their path.
It was truly a hellish scene.
b2_ch13: It was truly a journey beyond imagination.
5000 metres... No, they must have climbed higher than that. Looking down, they could see
clouds below them as they climbed the frozen mountain slope.
Breathing became difficult... Dizziness hindered them... Their endurance was approaching its limits.
b2_ch14: The unexpected truth revealed by Xane was a shock to Marth.
Tiki was born as the daughter of the Divine Dragon King, Naga, and by the king's will,
she fell into a deep sleep in the temple.
The king was a loving father, but feared Tiki's power.
If Tiki were to awaken, her tremendous power would eventually destroy the world...
That is what the Divine Dragon King believed.
However, Bantu, the king's servant, became attached to Tiki after watching over her for a period of hundreds of years.
He woke her from her sleep and took her away. Tiki only had 10 years of memories of life as a human...
"I feel so sorry for Tiki..." Marth couldn't control the emotions welling up inside him.
b2_ch15: Marth and his companions were transported to the outskirts of Altea by Archsage Gato's great warp magic,
and finally begin the battle to liberate their homeland.
The commander of Archanea's army, General Eibel, ordered the Gra Knights to charge, in order to buy time.
At the same time he prepared many dishonourable tactics, and was waiting for the chance to defeat Altea's army in one swift blow.
With his beloved homeland before him, Marth's battle was about to begin once again.
"Recapture the royal capital of Anri! We must take back our homeland!"
Prince Marth's voice resounded through Altea's clear, bright skies.
His arduous journey was finally about to reach its destination.
b2_ch16: It was a fierce battle like no other, but Marth's homeland of Altea had been liberated.
All that remained was to take the castle... "If we can regain Altea Castle, where I was born...
Thank you, everyone... Thank you so much for believing in me..."
A single tear glistened on Marth's cheek...
And the eyes of the girl, who gently wiped it away, were also streaming with tears...
b2_ch17: Marth and his companions once again moved out from Altea, and headed toward Pales, the capital of Archanea.
In their path was the Kingdom of Gra, an ally of Archanea.
In the previous war, Gra sided with the Dolhr Empire, and lost its king, Jiol, in battle.
After that, The kingdom fell into ruin.
The country was annexed by Altea, but later, it was returned to Archanea by order of Emperor Hardin.
Hardin found Princess Sheena, he daughter of King Jiol, and placed her on the throne, thus supporting Gra.
Sheema received fervent support from the people of Gra.
To them, Sheema was their only hope. The young people all volunteered to become soldiers.
They were happy to set out for battle and have a chance to defeat their archenemy, Altea.
Faced with the approaching Altean elites, Gra's soldiers lost the will to fight and fled for their lives.
b2_ch18: To avoid unnecessary battles, the Altean army decided to cross the central mountains, said to be impassable for a large army.
Once they crossed Adria Pass, they would be in the city of Pales.
"Hurry, we must not let the enemy spot us! We must charge through in one go!"
Marth's army carried on their advance across the narrow mountain path with a sense of hopeful anticipation.
However, their hopes were in vain. Halfway up the mountain pass, they were attacked by an unexpected enemy.
It was the elite squad of the northern kingdom of Aurelis, the Wolf Knights,
which was heading south to aid Archanea.
b2_ch19: It is the second month of the third year of the Imperial calendar...
Archanea's holy capital of Pales was enveloped in an unusually quiet atmosphere.
Due to the civil war in Archanea, many talented knights, including the paladin Midia, were captured.
Even so, Archanea still had a military force twice the size of Altea's, filling the streets of Pales.
Nearly a year had passed since the Grustian Expedition.
And so, the final battle, which would decide the fate of both nations, was about to begin.
b2_ch20: Saint Archanea was the largest country on the continent.
Its golden capital of Pales boasted a history of 600 years.
It fell in just one day to the army of the Altean Alliance.
The citizens of Archanea welcomed them as liberators, and offered their full cooperation.
They also expressed their hatred towards Hardin and his personal guards inside the castle.
People called Hardin the Dark Emperor. They hated him for the murder of countless people.
Avoiding a battle would have been preferable, but at this point it was inevitable...
Marth raised the flag of Anri high, and gave his final command.
"Go forth, heroes of Altea! This is the final battle. All troops, charge into Pales Castle!"
b2_ch21: Guided by Archsage Gotoh, Marth and his companions travelled to the Wyvern Valley in northern Macedon.
It was an untamed wilderness inhabited by wild flying dragons and ruled by barbarians.
There was no time for delay, because the fate of the world rested in Marth's hands!
b2_ch22: A stone bridge spanned across the towering, rocky mountains,
and a stone staircase spiraled upward, seemingly reaching all the way to the distant heavens.
The jagged rock face rumbled eerily, occasionally breathing as though it were alive.
The Dragon's Altar... An ancient ruin of the dragon tribe, The place where the Divine Dragon King, Naga, sealed away the Earth Dragons.
Now, after 600 years, the Earth Dragons were awakening once again, and countless evil demons were being born...
